# PhraseCut

> Learn words from sentences you like. Paste your text or explore English article excerpts by interest; translate, practice listening, and export vocabulary online. Save and review in the native app.

The free website recommends excerpts from updating Wikipedia, Global Voices, NASA, and Wikivoyage sources, with original links and licenses. Recommendations are currently in English; pasted text supports 20 translation languages. Refreshing the source cache does not mean an article was published today.

The website has no saved history or review library. Native apps provide local saving and spaced repetition. Native version 1.4.0 (33), with dynamic recommendations and listening practice, is available on the App Store as of October 25, 2026. Installed versions 1.3.0 and earlier still use legacy quotes until updated. New recommendations need internet access. This file is an optional navigation aid, not a sitemap, robots policy, or Google ranking requirement.

## Product

- [Product facts](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/product-facts.md): Feature and release boundaries, content sources, freshness, languages, translation providers, and CSV attribution.
- [Online tool](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/study): Interest-based English excerpts, sentence and word translation, adjustable pronunciation, CSV and Anki CSV export.
- [Help](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/help): Native app learning and review workflow.

## Learning guides

- [Learn words from sentences](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/learn-words-from-sentences): A practical workflow with examples.
- [Sentence-based vocabulary](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/sentence-based-vocabulary): Keep words connected to their context.
- [CSV and Anki export](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/export-language-study-materials): Web exports, source attribution, and native library exports.

## Localized tools

- [English](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/study): Translate sentences and words free online. Explore English excerpts from updating sources by interest, repeat pronunciation, and export CSV or Anki CSV. No account.
- [简体中文](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/zh-hans/study): 免费在线整句与逐词翻译，按兴趣从持续更新的公开来源获取英文摘句、调速朗读，并导出 CSV 或 Anki CSV。无需注册，也可粘贴其他外语文本学习词汇。
- [繁體中文](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/zh-hant/study): 免費線上整句與逐字翻譯，依興趣從持續更新的公開來源取得英文摘句、調速朗讀，並匯出 CSV 或 Anki CSV。不需註冊，也可貼上其他外語文字學習單字。
- [हिन्दी](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/hi/study): मुफ्त वाक्य और शब्द अनुवाद करें। अपडेट होते स्रोतों से रुचि के अनुसार अंग्रेज़ी अंश चुनें, उच्चारण दोहराकर सुनें और CSV या Anki CSV निर्यात करें। खाता जरूरी नहीं।
- [Indonesia](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/id/study): Terjemahkan kalimat dan kata gratis. Pilih kutipan Inggris dari sumber yang terus diperbarui, ulangi pelafalan, dan ekspor CSV atau Anki CSV. Tanpa akun.
- [Tiếng Việt](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/vi/study): Dịch câu và từng từ miễn phí. Chọn trích đoạn tiếng Anh từ nguồn được cập nhật, nghe lặp lại và xuất CSV hoặc Anki CSV. Không cần tài khoản.
- [Português](https://phrase-cut.luopeike.com/pt-br/study): Traduza frases e palavras grátis. Explore trechos em inglês de fontes atualizadas, repita a pronúncia e exporte CSV ou Anki CSV. Sem criar conta.
